title: D4 real faithfulness, over-segmentation & attention-decay
source: deterministic re-analysis of existing pipeline outputs; no model inference
integrity_notes: All numbers computed from artifacts already on disk; no inference run.
Out-of-ontology tokens are passed through verbatim and counted as violations, never silently remapped to flatter the score.
Physical-consistency uses CV posture (standing/ground) at segment midpoint; 'mixed'/'unknown' CV calls are excluded from the denominator.
GT-position agreement is a non-tautological signal (pred != GT here); the 50-video GT==prediction case is excluded entirely.
Detail density measures the LENGTH of notes/commentary, not content; no free text is copied into outputs.
